$comment: Smart Trust catalogue (Google Sheet 'Product Catalog' 2026-09-23 + photos in images/drive-download-20260923T215307Z-1-001). `file` is relative to that folder. `range` = the min–max shown in the filename (price stored = max, the retail end). Items without a range had no price in the sheet; their price was set by hand from Douala market levels and flagged with `priced: "estimate"`. Three sheet rows are skipped on purpose: 'Frames/Wind Frames/711afdce…' and 'Frames/Other frames/82a25353…' are byte-identical copies of files imported from their proper folder, and 'SIde chair table. 13000 - 16500 XAF.jpg' reuses the folding table set photo.
